response_200.summary:
Psychoeducational Evaluation Summary

Student Information: The student is a 10-year-old in 4th grade. Evaluation was completed on March 15, 2024 by a licensed school psychologist.

Referral Concerns: Difficulties with reading fluency, comprehension, and written expression; possible ADHD concerns.

Cognitive Assessment (WISC-V):
- Full Scale IQ: 88 (Low Average, 25th percentile)
- Verbal Comprehension Index: 92 (Average)
- Fluid Reasoning Index: 85 (Low Average)
- Processing Speed Index: 79 (Below Average, 8th percentile)

Academic Achievement (WIAT-4):
- Word Reading: 74 (4th percentile) — significantly below grade level
- Reading Comprehension: 78 (7th percentile)
- Spelling: 76 (5th percentile)
- Math Problem Solving: 91 (27th percentile)

Diagnoses Indicated: Specific Learning Disability in Reading (Dyslexia). ADHD Inattentive Type is noted as a differential requiring further evaluation.

Recommendations: Specialized reading instruction (Orton-Gillingham approach), extended time on assessments, preferential seating, and a reading specialist pull-out program 3x/week.
